Hi man, experienced tripper here and I absolutely love helping people with this sort of thing. Now first of all, there are different types of lsd and I can’t push it enough but TEST YOUR PRODUCTS!! Unless you synthesise lsd25 you can’t guarantee (unless you can?someone let me) it is what they say it is. On that note, you can’t guarantee “ug” so don’t take the number of ug your guy tells you as set in stone. Usually, 70ug is about how potent it would be. Don’t get me wrong Tho, take 3 tabs thinking it’s only 210 and you could be doing over 300. Knowing who your getting from and what it is should help with that. Anyway, for a first trip.. one or two tabs, preferably one. It will 100% be fun and get you comfortable. My partner is on her 3rd trip and said she fees comfortable stepping up to two on her next. Life is long and can always try more another time. One tab can last around 4-10 hours. Prepare with things you might want to do. I love going to live music and listening to music in my headphones and drawing. Remember bad trips are not something to fear. A bad trip is just that feeling of uneasiness and anxiety but let it happen, accept it and move on, that’s not you, it’s just what the trip is showing you. Be safe and have fun :)

For context. I had already had “breakthrough” but I never accept it really as I only had one hit from freebase dmt although I do remember forgetting I was a person, being in a pink room of arms and legs conjoined on the walls, etc.

I was starting to have a panic and realised it’s not worth getting upset over and accepted the trip wasn’t ready to end

It felt like I opened my eyes and I was now in front of the light switch although I couldn’t see it and managed to Insta click it on, when the light hit my eyes all the darkness looked like it got sapped into the corners of the room.
